verdict.rationale: FreshBooks' own API getting-started page lists a Postman Collection. A Postman collection is a machine-readable description of the API's requests, so it is a rough equivalent to a spec, but no OpenAPI or other formal schema is documented. Download details and the collection's completeness are not shown. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger or equivalent formal schema, documented download location and format, evidence the collection covers the full API surface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
